info.title: Legend of Exorcism
info.synopsis: Dopo aver lasciato il Palazzo Yaojin, Kong Hongjun arriva a Chang'an per combattere contro i demoni e stringe un legame con il capo della squadra esorcismo Li Jinglong.

overview.value: After leaving Yaojin Palace, Kong Hongjun arrives in Chang'an to battle demons and forms a bond with exorcism squad chief Li Jinglong.

translations.title: Legend of Exorcism
translations.overview: After leaving Yaojin Palace, Kong Hongjun arrives in Chang'an to battle demons and forms a bond with exorcism squad chief Li Jinglong.

translations.title: 天宝伏妖录
translations.overview: 天宝十二年，不谙世事的英俊少年孔鸿俊，肩负三项重任离开太行山上的曜金宫，来到歌舞升平、锦绣繁华的长安。孔鸿俊初入大唐驱魔司，顶头上司竟是不久前交过手的龙武军将领李景珑。而他竟然失手将陈氏心灯打碎，心灯进入了李景珑的体内。在那盏灯的光影里，有平康里的灯红酒绿、驱魔司夏日阳光下的梧桐、茫茫塞外的漫天风沙与飞雪、阿泰如清泉般的歌声、莫日根与陆许摘下的清晨树叶、裘永思飞扬的笔锋。

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sent to the mortal world, Hongjun must report to the Exorcism Department, find his father's killers, and retrieve the Heart Lamp. He fights a Flying Mastiff before arriving in the capital.

tmdb.synopsis: Sent to the mortal world, Hongjun must report to the Exorcism Department, find his father's killers, and retrieve the Heart Lamp. He fights a Flying Mastiff before arriving in the capital.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Hongjun shatters his divine shield upon meeting Captain Li Jinglong, accidentally merging a rare pendant into Li's body. Meanwhile, the Emperor plots to put Li in charge of exorcisms.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Hongjun, Mo Rigen, Atai, and Yongsi meet at the department. Jinglong arrives angry but is knocked out by mistake. Once awake, he assumes command and starts a massive renovation.

tmdb.title: Episodio 3

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The team buys the Wisdom Sword and investigates a missing cat. While staking out a brothel, they find fox fur and a dried corpse, while Lady Guo secretly drains palace maids.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Using music as bait, the team corners three hidden fox demons. Jinglong and Hongjun team up in a fierce street battle to slay the demon Jin Yun after city guards are wiped out.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The team tracks a lone demon to the palace. Later, an infatuated guard frees a captured fox demon, leading to a final ambush where the vengeful demon Fei Ao is cornered and killed.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: During a treacherous night battle at the imperial palace, the magical Shanhe Brush displays its immense, universe-shaping power as the entire Exorcism Department faces a deadly crisis.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Sinister demons infiltrate the Imperial Academy, causing dark currents to surge during the autumn exams. The Exorcism Department launches a high-stakes hunt across the grounds.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Li Jinglong uncovers a massive, deep-rooted conspiracy orchestrated by the fox clan. Amid a lively celebration by the poetic railings, hidden dangers lurk just out of sight.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: A wave of frequent, brutal murders plagues the city of Chang'an. Inner demons grow stronger as the entire family of Qin Wu is ruthlessly exterminated by dark forces.

episodes.synopsis: Deep, hidden mysteries are uncovered within the mystical Sumeru Mustard Seed. The entire Exorcism Department falls victim to a terrifying and deceptive Blood Luo illusion.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: A dangerous dragon offspring emerges from the shattered Blood Luo illusion to steal human souls. Simultaneously, the legendary Golden-Winged Roc appears over Chang'an.
